name: Emdash
description: Em rules and en rules alternating on a fixed count, set out like a line of dashes in cold type.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; top: 44%; width: 84%; height: 12%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match(@x % 3 == 0) { :after { left: 32%; width: 36%; } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
